# Cross

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Generate all unique pairs from an array. For example, [1, 2, 3] produces [[1, 2], [1, 3], [2, 3]].
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/cross",
  "type": "CrossOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/cross').par.data` (an input) and `op('/cross').out.pairs` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.data`, `out.pairs`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Name | Type | Default |
|------|------|---------|
| `data` | `DataField` | `[]` |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Outputs

<!-- gen:begin outputs -->
| Name | Type |
|------|------|
| `pairs` | `DataField` |
<!-- gen:end outputs -->
